info.title: ASTRA API
info.description: ASTRA — Astronaut Self-assessment, Tracking and Response Assistant. Decision-support prototype for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Not an autonomous doctor. All demo data is SYNTHETIC; rules marked DEMONSTRATION_ONLY are not clinical thresholds.

post.description:
Validates each observation independently (metric, unit, value range, timestamp, identity, device),
stores accepted observations with provenance, runs the assessment engine, creates alerts and publishes
real-time events. Idempotent by observation_id and optional `Idempotency-Key` header.
